risks.proof: A video of the transmission being operated through a gear selector or a hydraulic pump test.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number stamped on the casing.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing internal components or have significant wear.
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission with the input shaft removed to inspect the splines.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number stamped on the transmission casing.
Video of the transmission being operated to confirm it moves and shifts gears.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
